reading_scope: Complete bytes and JSON traversal; substantive all-asset/all-block inspection. Historical text archives fully indexed with relevant semantic review, not manual interpretation of every historical line.

initial_risk_registry.thesis: Model 2 Trend Pullback LONG into post-sweep liquidity zone defended by 35.9M USD L3 whale wall cluster at 82,303 - 82,615 USD with TP front-running 84,350 USD buy stop pool

method_notes.ema: Recursive EMA alpha=2/(n+1), initialized with first available close. Diagnostic finite-history estimates only; no HTF EMA200 certification.
method_notes.cvd: Last-observed windows and root-as_of wall-clock windows distinct; no missing bucket imputation. Empty windows have null delta.
method_notes.basis: Use source-specific rolling median for mapping; instantaneous column difference is a diagnostic, not a synchronized live basis.
method_notes.wall: Elapsed duration is inspected independently of retired eligibility booleans; sampled gaps do not establish uninterrupted order life.
method_notes.cost: USD-linear min-lot spread friction is a lower bound using 14.50 maximum risk; FX rounded zero is unknown, not zero cost.
method_notes.tournament: Single-assistant rubric adaptation; no independent agents or judge.
